correctness.rationale: The two sign components x=epsilon z with z in 1+4Z_2 are invariant. In logarithmic coordinates F(z)=exp(z log z), G(z)=exp(-z log z), and each map is isometric. The displacement doubling lemma follows by comparing 2D(z) to D(Tz)-D(z) at one higher 2-adic order, and persists under squaring. For F, v2(F(z)-z)=2u; for G, first displacement has r+1 and G^2 displacement 3r, giving the displayed exact periods. Finite valuation-layer cardinalities yield cycle multiplicities and two maximal cycles for k>=6. Independent modular-exponentiation orbit enumeration k=1..10 matched k=8 counts (18,15,4,4,2). Finite checks corroborate; 2-adic induction proves all k.
